video_title: Was ECF Game 2 Knicks' Turning Point? Series Analysis + Josh Recaps His MASSIVE Performance

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on his performance and analytics-based defensive adjustments
quotes.excerpt: You can't measure the heart. He had heart that game.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: We went from not playing the fourth quarter to being five of 11 from three. Analytics told you not to play Josh in the fourth, but hey, you can't measure the heart.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: That's what you said. You can't measure the heart. He had heart that game.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on his analytical approach to shooting three-pointers
quotes.excerpt: Analytically speaking, if I shoot five threes the next game, I will make three of them.
quotes.quote: Analytically speaking, I was one for five from three the first game and I shot 40% from three this year. Analytically speaking, of those, if I shoot five threes the next game, I will make three of them. So analytically speaking, you should guard me a little bit more that game closer because I'm just saying, analytically, you can't live and die by analytics.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on his mindset during high-volume three-point shooting games
quotes.excerpt: I just kind of do whatever the hell I feel like doing in the moment.
quotes.quote: I just kind of do whatever the hell I feel like doing in the moment. I think that might have been the most threes I ever shot in a game. I don't really like shooting 11 threes, but if they go in, cool.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on his experience playing with Alex Caruso
quotes.excerpt: I played with Alex Caruso, obviously not two years, and being with him in practice, he could shoot.
quotes.quote: I played with Alex Caruso, obviously not two years, and being with him in practice, he could shoot. I never really understood that because he could shoot. It's different because you don't know how those shots come about. I didn't shoot well the Atlanta series. I don't know how many threes I shot, and a lot of my shots were more towards the end of the shot clock.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the importance of contesting shots in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Everyone is an NBA player and everyone works on shots consistently.
quotes.quote: Everyone is an NBA player and everyone works on shots consistently. So you should always at least kind of close out, whether it's a late contest. You can always contest. I think at that game they just didn't contest him at all and he was just cashing out.
